The research facility did not submit their USDA fiscal year (FY) 25 Annual Report to the Deputy Administrator on or before
the extended deadline due date of 12/31/25. Research facilities that use or intend to use live animals in research, tests,
experiments, or for teaching shall submit an annual report, that covers the numbers of animals used during the previous
Federal fiscal year, to the Deputy Administrator on or before the December due date in this Subchapter of the AWA.
Timely submission of the annual report is essential to provide an accurate accounting of the total number of animals used
and to ensure that professionally acceptable standards governing the care and use of animals were followed during the
previous Federal fiscal year reporting period. The research facility must correct by submitting their USDA FY 25 Annual
Report by 8/25/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
